unit: T3 / Unit E — closer dashboard boot order + client control panel honesty
whatChanged: The closer dashboard now actually asks for the deal figures instead of giving up before it starts, so the five money boxes can fill in. On the client control panel: a new "Card Use" box shows how much of the client's credit is in use (and says "not measured" when nobody measured it, never a made-up 0%); the three bureau pull buttons now say up front whether this client has agreed to a credit pull, instead of looking fine and only failing after you tap; when a pull is refused the screen now says which problem it is ("no consent" versus "no identity on file") instead of one grey line; and the dead "GHL Contact" button is gone.

It fails ON PURPOSE when a listed screen gets fixed, with the message 'closer-dashboard.html (T3) is fixed - delete its line from KNOWN_UNFIXED in this file'. My Part 1 fix is what tripped it. The fix is to delete lines 79-81 of src/http/calendar-paint.test.mjs (the "closer-dashboard.html": entry and its two-line note). I did NOT make that edit because the file is not in my unit and T4 and T11 each have their own line to delete in the same map - one owner should do all three or they will collide. I did not weaken or skip anything.

Raw Report button: LEFT DISABLED, as instructed, because the data is not on the wire. A bureau pull writes a crs_results row and nothing else - src/finance/crs-pull.mjs contains zero references to `documents`, and src/documents/kinds.mjs has no raw-bureau-report subtype to file one under. The only way to reach a document's bytes is api/documents/[id].mjs, which 404s without a signature (api/documents/[id].mjs:47-55), and the only minter of that signature is a POST response (api/documents-upload.mjs:140-142); the readable GET, /api/read/documents, strips storage_key by design. So there is nothing to link to without a server change. I wrote that reasoning into an HTML comment above the button.

Journey docs: CLAUDE.md §4 wants the matching <name>-actual.md updated in the same commit and a CHANGELOG line appended. Those files are not in my unit, so I did not touch docs/. role-closer-actual.md is the one my Part 1 change affects.
notes: PART 1 - the boot-order bug is provably gone, without a browser. I wrapped the whole wiring block (was an IIFE at closer-dashboard.html:858-1247) in document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ...), copying the pattern and comment style already at client-control-panel.html:669-675. I did not remove `defer` and did not add a loader. The independent proof: src/http/calendar-paint.test.mjs has a scanner that flags screens reading FHData during page parse, it listed closer-dashboard.html as broken, and it now reports the screen as clean. That is the same defect the live audit saw, measured by a tool rather than by eye.

PART 2a - Card Use. The endpoint has always returned this and the screen never showed it; the field is spelled the British way, `utilisation`, at src/http/client-detail.mjs:310. New tile sits next to Scores in the existing metrics row (no new page, tab or sidebar row). cardUse() returns "not measured" only when percent is null/blank/non-numeric; a genuine 0 still renders "0%". Unknown survives to the screen.

PART 2c - consent state. New line above the pull buttons reads GET /api/consent/capture?client_id=<id>&kind=soft_pull_consent and paints one of THREE states. Allowed: green, buttons on. Blocked: red, buttons off, the reason printed next to them AND put on each button's tooltip, plus a 'Record consent for this client' link to consent-capture.html?client_id=<id> (hidden when the reason is 'revoked', because revoked means stop, not go re-collect). Could-not-check: grey, buttons LEFT ALONE - a failed check is not evidence of a missing consent. The wording matches consent-capture.html so the two screens cannot tell a closer two different stories.

PART 2d - refusal codes. pullFailure() maps the machine code to a plain sentence: consent_required, identity_required, not_configured, no_reports, provider_result_id_required, not_stored, failed, plus a 403-with-no-code case. For consent_required it keeps the server's own sentence, which already distinguishes revoked from expired from never-given (src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:242). The raw code is appended in square brackets so it can be quoted. A consent refusal also re-runs the consent check so the line above the buttons stops claiming the pull was allowed.
Left exactly as found, on instruction: the Open Bank Inbox button (T8's), the read-only notes box, public/app/shell.js, sidebar.fragment.html, data.js.
